tools.description: Semantic search over Japan's official government white papers: the Ministry of Defense white paper (防衛白書, 2025 edition) and METI's trade white paper (通商白書, 2025 edition). Use this when the user asks about Japanese defense policy, the Self-Defense Forces, Japan's security environment, defense budgets
